title: Omwoyo Omugumiikiriza
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo by’obunnabbi, waaliwo emmeeme obugumiikiriza bwe bwawandiikibwa mu lugoye lwennyini olw’obulamu bwabwe. Okuyita mu maziga n’ebiseera, baanywerera ku ssuubi, ne bafuuka ekyokulabirako ekitaggwaawo eky’okwesiga amagezi ag’obwakatonda. Osobola okusumulula ekyama kya ffiga eno etakyukakyuka?
clues: Nnazaalibwa mu maka ga bannabbi, naye ate ekigezo kyange ekisinga obunene kyayita mu mwana gwe nnali nsinga okwagala.
Nafuna okulabulwa okw’obuggya okuva mu kirooto mutabani wange kye yafuna, era nnatya olw’obukuumi bwe.
Amaaso gange ne geeru olw’ennaku, naye ate nga sifiirwa kukkiriza mu kusaasira kwa Allah.
Akawoowo k’omwana wange eyali abuze kaantuukako nga ndi wala, era awo nnamanya nti okuddamu okusisinkana kwali kumpi.
Ab’omu maka gange baafukamira nga beebaza okwolesebwa okw’edda bwe kwatuukirira, era n’amaaso gange gazzeemu okulaba.
Nze eyayanjulwa essaati eyabaddemu omusaayi, oluvannyuma ne nfuna essaati eyawonya amaaso gange.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
